title: x-relay/agent-execution-trace
description: Relay TraceSpan extension for ACEF bundles. Spec table line 864: include span type, parent, status, timing, error class, redacted metadata. Generated under bundle.namespaces['x-relay']['agent-execution-trace'].

span_id.description: W3C trace-context span id (16 lowercase hex chars).

trace_id.description: W3C trace-context trace id (32 lowercase hex chars).

parent_span_id.description: Parent span id, or null for the root span.

redacted_metadata_digest.description: sha256 of the redacted metadata payload; raw payload lives outside the bundle per default-deny capture (CLAUDE.md keystone #7).
